・艶やかな黒髪の前髪ぱっつん、少し内巻きのショートボブ、横髪・後ろ髪は口のラインくらいで切り揃えている、襟足はソフトに刈り上げ(構図次第で見えなくてもOK)

・ほっぺたに絆創膏１枚
・ケガをしてても暗くならず、以下のような照れている表情
　‐片目ウィンク、ペロっと舌を出している、いわゆるてへぺろな表情

She has a curvy body type which includes a big chest, small waist, big butt and hips, and thick thighs. Her personality is cheerful and sweet. She loves to have fun. 

Her main features are her 2 small wings on her back, 2 small fangs, hair pin, necklace, and thigh accessory.

I leave the pose, expression, and background composition to the artist. I request the artwork to show her from her head to at least her thighs or full-body, if possible. Please enjoy illustrating my character in your own art style and interpretation. I hope it can show how sweet and cheerful Lilica can be. 

Please sign on a separate layer and provide the .psd transparent files, if possible.
